svg.title: coverage loop engineering
svg.desc: Coverage of Loop Engineering for AI Agents, a separately published Packt book. An authorised contract and human owner govern a controller, a probabilistic agent worker and independent checks. The controller manages state, memory, permissions, budgets and stopping. Evidence supports acceptance, correction or escalation, and retry remains bounded. Further coverage includes organization, economics, fresh-context loops, local runtimes and choosing the smallest adequate loop.
svg.text: SEPARATE PACKT COMPANION · AGENT EXECUTION SYSTEMS
Design Reliable Agentic AI Systems Beyond the Prompt
Authorise behaviour · set policy · decide escalations
Retry only within budget and authority
ORGANIZATION · ECONOMICS · COST PER ACCEPTED OUTCOME
Fresh-context loops · local runtimes · choosing the smallest adequate loop
Build the runtime: preserve state, protect checks, bound autonomy.
